payload.name: Distribution Scheduler
payload.description: The Distribution Scheduler Configuration defines how the Scheduler will operate within this App.

payload.name: MES
payload.description:
Work Order RoutingExternal applies to the importation of Work Orders from NetSuite. When External: True, the routings configured in Fuuz will be ignored when importing/updating work orders from NetSuite.

OSPExternal: When true, it means transfer orders, etc. must be configured to work in/out of Fuuz. When False, the OSP process will be handled completely within Fuuz.

StrategyRoutingExternal: When True, all processes/details will be taken from the external system - if False, even if detail is provided from the external system - all BOM will be flattened and placed under a "Default" process in Fuuz - the premise being the customer will then configure all necessary routing details directly within Fuuz product management.

Allow Overage on Item Receipts: When True - will allow a user to perform an over receipt against a Purchase Order Line Release within Fuuz

workorderRoutingExternal.description: Work Order RoutingExternal: applies to the importation of Work Orders from NetSuite - when External:True - means the routings configured in Fuuz will be ignored on the import/udpate of work orders from netSuite.
